# 1 · The business and its questions

[← 0 · Architecture](00-architecture.md) · Next: [2 · Source data →](02-source-data.md)

AI-ready data starts from the **questions**, not from the tables. Before building anything,
write down who will ask what. Those questions decide the grain of the facts, which attributes
the dimensions need, which metrics must be governed, and later become the Genie benchmarks.

## FreshCart

FreshCart is a fictional grocery retailer:

| store_id | store_name | store_format | city | region | country | open_date | store_status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 317 | FreshCart Toronto Liberty Village | Supercenter | Toronto | Canada | Canada | 2018-06-02 | Open |
| 322 | FreshCart Mississauga Square One | Express | Mississauga | Canada | Canada | 2025-06-14 | Open |
| 2305 | FreshCart Chicago Lincoln Park | Supercenter | Chicago | Midwest | United States | 2012-04-21 | Open |
| 1042 | FreshCart Boston Seaport | Supercenter | Boston | Northeast | United States | 2016-05-14 | Open |
| 1107 | FreshCart Hartford West | Express | West Hartford | Northeast | United States | 2019-10-05 | Open |
| 9001 | FreshCart Newark Fulfilment Center | Dark Store | Newark | Northeast | United States | 2023-03-11 | Open |
| 2210 | FreshCart Atlanta Midtown | Neighborhood Market | Atlanta | Southeast | United States | 2014-08-09 | Open |
| 2211 | FreshCart Atlanta Buckhead | Express | Atlanta | Southeast | United States | 2017-03-18 | Closed |
| 3050 | FreshCart Denver Highlands | Neighborhood Market | Denver | West | United States | 2024-09-07 | Open |

- Four formats: Supercenter, Neighborhood Market, Express, and a **Dark Store** that only fulfils online orders.
- Stores in two countries, so sales arrive in **USD and CAD**; group reporting is in USD.
- A **4-5-4 retail fiscal calendar**: fiscal years start on the Sunday nearest 1 February,
  weeks run Sunday to Saturday, and some years have 53 weeks (FY2023 did).
- A loyalty programme with Gold, Silver and Bronze tiers.
- Weekly promotions: buy-one-get-one, percent off, multi-buy and member prices.

Three things happened during the data period that the questions must handle correctly:

1. **Boston Seaport was remodelled** from a Neighborhood Market into a Supercenter on 1 February 2026 (start of FY2026).
2. **Mississauga Square One opened** on 14 June 2025, so it is not comparable (like-for-like) until FY2027.
3. **Atlanta Buckhead closed** on 30 May 2026, so it drops out of like-for-like comparisons.

## The agent's scope

**FreshCart Sales & Stock Assistant**: for category managers, regional operations managers and
finance business partners. It answers questions about sales, margin, baskets, promotions, loyalty
and stock. It does **not** cover labour, supplier deliveries or individual customer records.
Writing the out-of-scope list down early saves arguments later.

## The question inventory

These are the questions collected from the (fictional) business experts, and what each one
**requires from the data**:

| # | Question | What the data must provide |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | What were net sales and margin by region last week? | One definition of net sales; cost for margin; a "last completed fiscal week" flag |
| 2 | How are we trading year to date versus last year? | Same fiscal days last year, not calendar dates |
| 3 | What is like-for-like growth this year by region? | Comparable-store rule; trusted calculation |
| 4 | Which categories rely most on promotions this quarter? | Promotion flag per line; ratio measure |
| 5 | Rank the Snacks subcategories by margin % | Product hierarchy decoded; ratio of sums |
| 6 | Do Gold members spend more per basket than Silver? | Loyalty tier without personal data; basket count |
| 7 | What share of sales is online, by region? | In-store and online in one fact with a channel column |
| 8 | How did the Boston Seaport store trade week by week this year? | Store names users type (and misspell) |
| 9 | What is the return rate in Household over the last four weeks? | Returns as negative lines; sales before returns |
| 10 | Where are we out of stock most often in fresh departments? | Daily stock snapshots; a definition of "fresh" |
| 11 | How much Produce stock did we hold at the end of last week? | Stock treated as semi-additive (last day, not the sum) |
| 12 | Which stores opened in FY2025? | Store opening dates in fiscal years |

Each requirement in the right-hand column maps to a transformation you will see in the next docs.
Keep this table open as you read: every step exists to make one of these answers correct.
